1.Identifying Sets Closed Under Addition and Scalar Multiplication?

Let S be the set of all polynomials with real coefficients and whose degree is greater than or equal to 2. Which of the following statements are true?

  1. f(x)∈S, where f(x)=2x.
  2. For every p(x),q(x)∈S, we have p(x)+q(x)∈S.
  3. The set is closed under addition.

  1. The zero-polynomial belongs to F.
  2. For the zero polynomial 0 and any p(x)∈F, we have p(x)+0=p(x).
  3. There are polynomials p(x),q(x)∈F such that p(x)+q(x)≠q(x)+p(x).

  3. For any p(x)∈U and α,β∈R, we have (α+β)p(x)=αp(x)+βp(x).
